transport: Every physical handoff instantiates station_contracts.transport_contract; route adjacency never teleports a specimen.
device_process_rule: Robot owns stock/preparation/loading/settings/start/readback/unloading. Instrument owns regulated heat, printing/cutting motion, crosshead motion, radiation or scan. No physical execution is performed by this package.
